title: Provenance
description: What the Desk records today about where a model answer came from: one row per model request, with the provider-neutral completion (finish reason and token counts) and the phase it served. Read from ExecutionCheckpoint.completions (web/src/assistant/execution/state.ts) and ModelCompletion (web/src/assistant/completion.ts, readCompletion; Go aifailure.Completion). Open: readCompletion and readExecution accept members they do not name. A request the provider refused and that was sent again has one row per attempt (packages/harness/engines/vercel/retry.ts; execution/controller.ts, recordRefusal): the refused attempt's row carries attempt, failure and waitMs, and the attempt that answered carries its attempt number. There is no model name, adapter or contract version, prompt digest or request timing in any record that crosses the slot (waitMs is the wait before a retry, not a timing) (see docs/design/wire-contract.md, Open questions).

request.description: Which model request of the execution this was, counted from 1; at most the checkpoint's used count.

phase.description: work: the main loop. synthesis: the one tool-free request that finishes a response cut short. review: the critic.

attempt.description: Which attempt at this request the row records, from 1, where the provider refused the request and it was sent again: at most three (two retries). Absent on a request answered at its first attempt.

failure.description: On a refused attempt's row: the refusal, classified (outcome refused). The row's result has finishReason error.

waitMs.description: On a refused attempt's row: the wait before the next attempt, in milliseconds, the longer of the backoff (1000, then 2000) and the provider's Retry-After; at most 30000 as the vercel engine waits, and readExecution accepts up to a day. Absent where no attempt followed.

completion.description: Provider-neutral completion metadata (ModelCompletion). Never raw provider text or reasoning. Open: readCompletion keeps only these members and drops any other.

finishReason.description: COMPLETION_REASONS. A reason outside the list is recorded as other.

cacheReadTokens.description: Input tokens the provider read from its prompt cache, where it reports them (the SDK's inputTokenDetails.cacheReadTokens). Recorded by this harness since agent#9; the Desk's Go reader drops it until its swap.

cacheWriteTokens.description: Input tokens the provider wrote to its prompt cache, where it reports them (inputTokenDetails.cacheWriteTokens). Recorded by this harness since agent#9; the Desk's Go reader drops it until its swap.

tokens.description: A count the provider reported; a safe integer, never negative. Absent where the provider reported none.

sha256.description: A lower-case hex SHA-256 digest, as the Desk writes requestKey, retained-entry digests and the project brief's header.

requestKey.description: The SHA-256 of the JSON text {"request":…,"phase":…,"purpose":…} for the person's current request (ExecutionController.initialize). It binds a checkpoint to the request it was made for; it is not a digest of the prompt sent to the model.

engine.description: The engine id a session ran on (Engine.id, the AssistantEngine identifier). Held by the host, never carried on an event.
